subject: [PATCH v2 01/17] selftests/mm: skip collapse_compound_extreme where the PMD is too large

2026-08-07.patch_summary: This patch modifies a selftest to skip a test case where the PMD (Page Map Directory) size is too large, specifically larger than 32M. The test in question, collapse_compound_extreme, relies on being able to allocate multiple PMD-order allocations, which becomes unreliable for very large PMDs. By skipping this test case when the PMD size exceeds 32M, the patch prevents a failure that would cause the entire binary to stop running and lose subsequent test cases.
